import Foundation
import QuosparrCore
// usage: gen_billing in.json out.json
let args = CommandLine.arguments
let inputs = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: args[1]))) as! [String]
let now = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_800_000_000)

func isoMs(_ d: Date) -> String {
    let f = ISO8601DateFormatter()
    f.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
    return f.string(from: d)
}
let enc = JSONEncoder()
enc.outputFormatting = [.sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes]
enc.dateEncodingStrategy = .custom { date, e in var c = e.singleValueContainer(); try c.encode(isoMs(date)) }

var out: [[String: Any]] = []
for (idx, s) in inputs.enumerated() {
    FileHandle.standardError.write(Data("\(idx)\n".utf8))
    let data = Data(s.utf8)
    var row: [String: Any] = [:]
    do {
        let snap = try GrokQuotaSnapshot.decodeBillingResponse(from: data, now: now)
        row["bill"] = String(data: try enc.encode(snap), encoding: .utf8)!
    } catch {
        row["billErr"] = String(describing: error)
    }
    do {
        let m = try GrokQuotaSnapshot.decodeMoneyAllowance(from: data)
        let l: Any = m.limitCents.map { String($0) as Any } ?? NSNull()
        let u: Any = m.usedCents.map { String($0) as Any } ?? NSNull()
        row["money"] = [l, u]
    } catch {
        row["moneyErr"] = String(describing: error)
    }
    row["plan"] = GrokQuotaSnapshot.decodeSettingsPlan(from: data) ?? NSNull()
    out.append(row)
}
try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.sortedKeys]).write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: args[2]))
